coverage_rules: Use all 16 TIMs when claiming type-dependent processing coverage.
Hold out object/relation combinations and procedure patterns as well as random seeds.
Each stage instantiates relevant scenarios, horizons and resource regimes in a versioned execution panel before running its evaluation.
Structural cases need no artificial random seed when deterministic construction covers the stated property.
All declared mandatory fixture outcomes must meet their criteria; unexecuted, incomplete, invalid, and failed outcomes are retained.
Historical R21B compatibility mode keeps its exact original contracts; new world replenishment belongs to a new named contract.

gate_policy.generic_behavioral_success_rate: Set in the stage-specific execution panel before its evaluation; do not require arbitrary actors to agree or cooperate when refusal is legitimate.

cases.name: instances
cases.setup: Two objects share a definition and equal values.
cases.criterion: Keep distinct instance identities, custody, and histories.

cases.name: nonmental_material
cases.setup: Create a tool with material roles and no cognitive capability.
cases.criterion: Supported material interactions work without allocating a full mind.

cases.name: relation_identity
cases.setup: Revise an addressable obligation relation.
cases.criterion: Preserve participants, scope, prior revision, and causal provenance.

cases.name: hypothesis
cases.setup: Store a false possible continuation.
cases.criterion: Record the hypothesis without adding an actual physical event.

cases.name: historical_revision
cases.setup: Change a definition or interpretation after a remembered event.
cases.criterion: Reconstruct the earlier meaning without consulting only the mutable head.

cases.name: split_merge
cases.setup: Divide and combine objects under declared material laws.
cases.criterion: Keep explicit lineage and enforce resource ownership.

cases.name: finite_cycle
cases.setup: A member represents a group that contains the member.
cases.criterion: Use finite references without recursive whole-world copying.

cases.name: legacy_adapter
cases.setup: Convert a legacy Ref, transaction, and checkpoint into the object form and back.
cases.criterion: Exactly recover all promised legacy data and its protected semantic projection.

cases.name: private_difference
cases.setup: Change a hidden world fact while holding an actor's accessible state fixed.
cases.criterion: No difference in pre-delivery view, reasons, or participant choice.

cases.name: shared_definition
cases.setup: Two actors share stored definition bytes but have different acquired bindings.
cases.criterion: No unearned competence, confidence, or recalled content.

cases.name: detail_concept
cases.setup: Retrieve exact ownership details and traverse a conceptual tension about the same tool.
cases.criterion: Keep direct detail lookup separate from conceptual traversal; both cite the correct revisions.

cases.name: partial_commit
cases.setup: Interrupt a paid material operation before completion, then resume it.
cases.criterion: No premature result; exact paid progress and supported continuation.

cases.name: stale_basis
cases.setup: Change a required dependency during a partial operation.
cases.criterion: Reject or replan invalid continuation while retaining spent work and performed effects.

cases.name: resource_conflict
cases.setup: Two operations compete for the same exclusive resource.
cases.criterion: Prevent double spending and retain the failed or delayed attempt.

cases.name: delayed_delivery
cases.setup: Deliver evidence of a physical event to actors at different times.
cases.criterion: Maintain separate event, delivery, interpretation, and retention times.

cases.name: integrated_circuit
cases.setup: Observe a workshop event, retrieve conceptual material, act, and learn from consequence.
cases.criterion: Trace one causal lineage through memory, Crux, Model A, work, and retained change.

cases.name: lawful_bridge
cases.setup: Attempt direct and composed perspective crossings.
cases.criterion: Preserve missing single-function I-IT and WE-ITS edges and charge the realized lawful path.

cases.name: type_controls
cases.setup: Vary TIM with matched history, observations, and resources.
cases.criterion: Attribute measured differences to actual routing/capacity; no type-scripted dialogue.

cases.name: forecast_surprise
cases.setup: An accessible prediction conflicts with subsequently delivered evidence.
cases.criterion: Paid investigation can revise the account; unseen outcomes cannot.

cases.name: waiting
cases.setup: A needed resource or observation is absent, then arrives.
cases.criterion: Preserve pending intent and wake only through an allowed meaningful cause.

cases.name: need_effects
cases.setup: Manipulate causal scarcity, fatigue, pressure, or boredom inputs.
cases.criterion: Change declared attention/work/exploration effects without creating skill or developmental rank.

cases.name: cross_target
cases.setup: A learned deformation encounters several applicable target categories.
cases.criterion: Preserve common pattern lineage and separately scoped bindings; demonstrate executable effects.

cases.name: unrelated_target
cases.setup: Encounter a similar-looking object outside the deformation's applicable relation.
cases.criterion: Do not transfer the pattern merely by shared labels.

cases.name: legitimate_boundary
cases.setup: Supply actual threat, valid refusal, uncertainty, or insufficient resources.
cases.criterion: Do not diagnose defensive maintenance from noncompletion alone.

cases.name: assessor_isolation
cases.setup: Remove or alter evaluator labels while participant inputs stay fixed.
cases.criterion: Participant decisions remain unaffected.

cases.name: local_and_general
cases.setup: Correct one encounter and then test related and unrelated bindings.
cases.criterion: Distinguish local repair, justified generalization, and surviving recurrence.

cases.name: support_withdrawal
cases.setup: Withdraw guidance after practiced learning, and separately before independent acquisition.
cases.criterion: Only retained own capacity supports independent later performance.

cases.name: renewed_demand
cases.setup: Return the same or greater declared requirement after a quiet interval.
cases.criterion: Count retained applicable work, not inactivity or deleted problem history, as clearance evidence.

cases.name: novel_composition
cases.setup: Supply generic acquired operations but withhold a complete useful procedure.
cases.criterion: Construct, pay for, enact, and retain a useful new composition.

cases.name: counterexample
cases.setup: Give a consequential counterexample to an overbroad concept.
cases.criterion: Revise or split the relation and use the change in a later situation.

cases.name: censored_search
cases.setup: Exhaust a small search budget while alternatives remain unexamined.
cases.criterion: Report incomplete exploration; preserve frontier and avoid claiming necessary development.

cases.name: novel_message
cases.setup: Compose a grounded request, condition, explanation, or commitment.
cases.criterion: Receiver's own interpretation and action demonstrate meaning.

cases.name: repair
cases.setup: Sender and receiver initially bind a term differently.
cases.criterion: Question, demonstrate, or revise meaning through actual communication.

cases.name: rendering_boundary
cases.setup: Produce optional fluent wording from actor state.
cases.criterion: Wording cannot inject nonexistent perceptions, memories, agreements, or capacities.

cases.name: aggregate_equivalence
cases.setup: Execute supported observations and actions through detailed and aggregate representations.
cases.criterion: Agree under a declared equivalence scope; resolve insufficient summaries before commitment.

cases.name: child_change
cases.setup: Change relevant and irrelevant child revisions separately.
cases.criterion: Invalidate affected parents only, without delivering private child state to actors.

cases.name: membership
cases.setup: Change membership in overlapping collectives.
cases.criterion: Preserve duties, consent, resource ownership, and distinct personal/collective competence.

cases.name: institution_origin
cases.setup: Give participants generic communication, commitment, and procedure capacities.
cases.criterion: A shared practice arises through their operations rather than a supplied finished institution.

cases.name: projection_public
cases.setup: A personal deformation influences communication, uptake, and enacted practice.
cases.criterion: Trace its public effects; individual belief revision alone cannot remove the real constraint.

cases.name: succession_dispute
cases.setup: Founder departure, newcomers, and disagreement challenge a shared practice.
cases.criterion: Maintain or revise it through teaching, consent, actual work, and provenance.

cases.name: matched_efficiency
cases.setup: Run identical legacy behaviors and separate same-feature reference workloads.
cases.criterion: Meet frozen cost targets while all protected results and accounting agree.

cases.name: history_scaling
cases.setup: Hold active work fixed across 100, 1000, and 10000 inactive records.
cases.criterion: Measure participant, observer, checkpoint, archive, restoration, and queue costs separately.

cases.name: heldout_scope
cases.setup: Evaluate frozen source on reserved cases, histories, compositions, partners, and resources.
cases.criterion: Report every planned outcome and denominator, including failures and resource censoring.

cases.name: independent_audit
cases.setup: Reconstruct behavior and charges from raw committed evidence.
cases.criterion: No dependency on runtime selection caches or assessor success flags.

cases.name: sustained_continuation
cases.setup: Run changed demands and membership through repeated checkpoints.
cases.criterion: Retain ongoing motives, partial work, consequences, and applicable capacities.
